# Assets · ScriptMarks

3 files under `assets/ScriptMarks/`, held in the system’s upload store: read one as the file `_blobs/<id>.<ext>` in this system’s directory, the id below as `<id>` (they are not files under that folder — a read by that path fails), then add it to your own work as an asset (`artifact.mjs upload`, where your tool lists that); an SVG may also be inlined. Copy assets, never approximate them.

## Use

```html
<img src="<the url the asset upload returned for script-mark-deep-blue.png>" alt="…">
```

## Usage notes

从原始 PDF 第 28 页直接裁出的三种 Script Mark。深蓝版使用 `color-brand-deep-blue`；黑色版用于不能彩色输出的场景；白色版保留原页的深蓝底。文件保留裁图背景，均为 PNG 参考资产，未重画标志，也未将裁图冒充 SVG 母版。
